integrity: Derivations and code are self-contained except for explicitly cited classical exact gap and coverage formulas. Numerics are finite diagnostic checks and not infinite certifications. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed length ratio L>1, thermodynamic substrate limit before rod-length limit, large-rod-first staged (Model I) expected terminal coverage only; no competing mixed arrivals, kinetic duration, finite-size fluctuations or concentration theorem. Equivalence to unindexed earlier formulations remains possible.
title: Integer-ratio smoothness thresholds in two-stage random sequential adsorption
